selection: Grouped validation only; mean whole/upper55/upper35 top1 + half top3, whole top1 floor baseline minus2pts. Test and city images excluded from selection.
limitations: Expanded Chinese/EV taxonomy plus existing24 models; see labels and grouped per-class counts. Candidate only; not promoted automatically. Upper crops simulate missing body parts; they are not a real street occlusion test. Source categories and sparse Cobalt/Damas examples remain limitations.

group_audit.policy: Keep old files/splits immutable. Exclude non-training members of cross-brand author/date sessions from all new validation/test views. No old heldout photo is moved into training.
group_audit.limitations: Author/date is an approximate session. True vehicle identity labels are unavailable for these public sources.

calibration: NLL temperature and >=90% accepted accuracy with >=20 examples, grouped validation whole+upper55+upper35 only; geometry-quality gate is separate.
